title.en: The hydrogen atom and atomic structure

summary.en: Solving the quantum mechanics of an electron bound to a single proton reproduces the discrete energy levels of hydrogen and introduces the quantum numbers that organise every atom's electron structure.
summary.et: Ühe prootoni külge seotud elektroni kvantmehaanika lahendamine annab vesiniku diskreetsed energiatasemed ja kvantarvud, mis korrastavad iga aatomi elektronstruktuuri.
